notes.title: GET LOST IN THE WOODS. BLOOBER TEAM BRINGS FEAR TO PC VR
notes.content:
Bloober Team is excited to share Blair Witch: VR Edition is now available on Steam. Optimized for PC VR platforms, Blair Witch: VR Edition will be available on Steam for $29.99. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576350/Blair_Witch_VR/

Blair Witch: VR Edition is an addition to the line-up of Blair Witch VR experiences previously only available on Oculus devices. The redesigned environments allow for more interactivity and accommodate new creature encounters. 

Watch the Blair Witch: VR Edition announcement trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W8kX1JOWUBM

Blair Witch: VR Edition is also now available on PSVR. Watch the Live-Action Trailer: https://youtu.be/EC3AqMjMeOQ

Features:
Improved Dog commands for Bullet:
● Pet Bullet to make sure he knows he's a good boy
● Change up his look with a variety of new collars
● Give Bullet treats. In the VR edition, he'll take them right from your hand
● Bullet can help you track scents through the forest, just give him an object to sniff
● Enjoy the company of your best buddy and shake his paw any time

Gameplay:
● Environments have been redesigned for more interactivity
○ Objects to catch, throw, or stack on top of each other
○ A marker to draw on paper and other objects
○ Drawers, doors, gates, and car trunk open at a touch
○ Breaking branches
○ Operation of mechanical elements: handles, buttons, opening locks with a key, padlock codes, etc...
● New control system
● New sounds and in-game events to surprise and scare the player.
● Additional creature encounters
● Unlockable Achievements and Trophies

Blair Witch: VR Edition is a story-driven psychological horror game from the creative minds behind the critically acclaimed Layers of Fear. Experience first-hand the toll that fear can take on the mind in an original story inspired by the cinematic lore of Blair Witch, designed for virtual reality.

The Blair Witch story has been rebuilt for PC head-mounted displays. With environments redesigned for more interactivity, new mechanics for your companion dog such as petting and fetching gestures, and additional creature encounters, you will experience the eerie atmosphere of the Black Hills Forest like never before. These cursed woods will awaken your darkest fears.

Find more about Blair Witch: VR Edition at:

notes.title: Patch 2.0 is live!
notes.content:
Dear VR players, the latest patch 2.0 for Layers of Fear VR is live! We fixed some minor bugs and physic issues, we have also introduced several improvements that increased immersion and enhanced certain scenes with new interactions and mechanics. Thank you very much for your feedback, good will and support!

And now... Put on your VR headsets and discover what awaits!

CHANGLELOG

- Fixed scene with blackout and wife
- Changed crosshair default value
- Fixed teleportation issues when unmounting headset
- Restored default distance that trigger events in final scene
- Sharper overall visuals
- Added support for up to x1.5 supersampling
- Added Immersive reading
- Improved final scene in chapter 3.
- Fixed minor UI issues.
- Fixed physics problems.
- Fixed minor bugs.
- Fixed audio problems.
- Fixed rare issue with doors reported by our players.

notes.title: No more teleports. Patch is live!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that the Patch 1.8 for Layers of Fear VR is live on Steam! This time we focused on fixing problems indicated by the players

CHANGELOG:
- Added controlling menus via laser pointers
- Fixed some bugs reported by players (issues with snapping to position when colliding with some pickable/interactive objects)
- Fixed teleportation issues

So, let's play a game and discover what awaits…

notes.title: Patch is live!
notes.content:
Dear VR players! We’re happy to announce that the Patch 1.7 for Layers of Fear VR is live on Steam! Many thanks to everyone who gave feedback.

CHANGELOG:
*Added support for HTC Vive Cosmos and Windows Mixed Reality (SteamVR required),
* Added Steam Cloud support,
* Added Steam Achievements,
* Removed color grading effects from menu,
* Made more items pickable,
* Visually enhanced menu,
* Fixed bugs, including light switch and padlock sometimes not working properly and the ghost getting stuck.

notes.title: Patch is live!
notes.content:
Dear VR players! Latest patch for Layers of Fear VR is live on Steam! Many thanks to everyone who gave feedback.

CHANGELOG:
- Valve Index support
- Added warning when player headset is not supported to logo screen
- Fixed blackscreen when checking usuported devices
- Fixed blackscreen when using Steam VR Beta
- Fixed some issues reported by players when moving around main hub
- Improved hand position for Valve Index and Oculus Rift CV1 on SteamVR. Fixed detection of Oculus Rift S on SteamVR
- Bathroom block movement fix

And more...
